  ADJOURNED MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, JANUARY 27, 2023 AT 8:30 AM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at
(626) 300­0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each
teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID­19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, it is recommended that
members of the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s
current Health Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID­19, you are encouraged to
provide input electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.

How to offer public comment from home:
  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment.
  Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments
  received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be
  read at the meeting.
  2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in­person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor
Huang, and Mayor Talt

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place
limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  市議會議程

Steve Talt，市長
  www.CityofSanMarino.org

  電話：(626) 300-0700
Tony Chou，市議員

  聖馬力諾市議會
  續會
  2023 年 1 月 27 日，星期五，上午 8:30
  CROWELL 公共圖書館，BARTH ROOM
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

聖馬力諾市政府感謝您出席。公民參與為市議會提供了有關社區問題的寶貴資訊。

每個月的第二個星期三下午 6 時舉行例會。通常，延期舉行的會議在每個月的最後一個星期五上午 8:30
舉行。

根據《美國殘障人士法》，任何需要合理照顧或便利以參加會議的殘障人士應在會議前與市書記官聯繋，
請求協助，電子郵件：CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org；電話：(626) 300-0705。

  根據加州衆議院第 361 號法案（AB 361）
市議員可以透過電話參加會議，而無需告知其參加公開會議的所在地點。

  新冠病毒疾病 (COVID-19) 通知
為了保護工作人員、我們的選民和民選官員，建議公眾按照州和縣衛生部門當前的命令在室內佩戴口罩。
鑑於新冠病毒疾病的嚴重性，如果您覺得親自出席不方便，我們鼓勵您透過電子方式提出意見。

議程 – 2023 年 1 月 27 日  第1頁/共3頁
 如何在家觀看或收聽會議：

  透過電腦接收視訊串流：
  網站：https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83331448957
  會議代碼：833 3144 8957
  透過電話僅接收音訊：
  電話號碼：(669) 900-9128
  會議代碼：833 3144 8957

公衆如何在家發表意見：
  公衆可使用電郵提出意見：CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org，截止時間是會議當天下午 3 時，
  由市書記官在公眾意見發表期間宣讀。為了節省時間，可能會對冗長的公眾意見進行總結。下午 3
  時後收到的任何意見都將包含在公眾意見紀錄中，但不會在會議上宣讀。
  會議期間提出的公眾意見將透過 zoom.us 電話會議模塊接受。透過 Zoom 提出的意見將在現場
  意見發表之後獲得接受。

宣佈開會

宣誓效忠美國

點名

市議員 Chou、市議員 Lo、市議員 Shepherd Romey、副市長 Huang 和市長 Talt

議程發佈

議程會在每次會議前 72 小時於以下地點發佈：City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive；Crowell Public
Library, 1890 Huntington Drive；Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive。議程還將在市政
府網站上發佈：http://www.cityofsanmarino.org。

公衆意見

市政府歡迎公衆提出意見和建議。公眾可以填寫公眾意見卡，並在會議舉行前將其交給市書記官，由市書
記官轉交給市議會。此時，公眾可以就未列入會議議程的事項向市議會提出意見。根據州法律，市議會不
得討論未列入會議議程的問題或就這些問題採取行動（政府法典第 54954.2 節）。市長保留限制意見時
間的權利。工作人員可能會按照指示對公衆提出的意見和建議進行跟進。

  新議題

 1.  2023-24  財 年 預 算 概 覽 和 優 先 計 劃 討 論

  建議：工作人員建議市議會參與討論，確定 2023-24 財年的潛在優先計劃。

議程 – 2023 年 1 月 27 日  第2頁/共3頁
 書面通訊或公開文件分發

這是公佈市議員收到的與市政府有關的任何書面通訊的機會。聖馬力諾市政府向至少大多數市議會成員分
發的關於本議程任何討論事項的所有公共文件將在市政廳公衆服務臺供公眾查閲，市政廳地址是：2200
Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108 ；並將包含在公共議程文件夾中，可在市議會開會
期間審閲。
